Disaster Recovery Excellence

We believe that as data demands grow and computing power increases, data center infrastructure will have to become more energy efficient otherwise rising energy costs will make even the smallest data center a losing economic proposition.

While the “green data center” movement is beginning to take hold, it is only a matter of time before the need to change isn’t simply driven by a desire to protect the environment but also driven by the economic reality of rising energy costs.

EMS’s patented closed loop cooling system uses a pre-engineered airflow and cooling built-in that is optimized to efficiently deal with the current and future demands of the world’s most powerful computer equipment

Closed loop cooling confines the hot and cold aisles within the enclosure so that cooling is applied directly to the equipment. This allows companies to manage power consumption, cooling delivery and temperature set points at the rack level.

This technology reduces cooling and and electrical costs up to 50% vs. a traditional data center.

EMS’ technology offers the lowest cost solution per kilowatt of compute capacity in the market place today -- as low as $5,000/KW vs. $15,000 to $20,000/KW for a traditional data center. 

Our goal is to move the data center industry from being a huge consumer of electricity to being a small consumer of clean energy.

Our AI pre-fills entry packets across multiple documents per shipment, eliminating manual re-keying. Live dashboards surface bond utilization, duty spend, and tariff exposure before CBP flags a problem.

For investors and partners: every shipment through ClearBond becomes structured risk data, making our pricing sharper, loss ratios better, and moat wider over time.

What’s a DAO? A DAO is an acronym for “Distributed Autonomous Organization”. Think of it as a membership club where people from diverse backgrounds blend their talents into synergistic projects. 

How does a DAO work? Decision making power is distributed across our organization, and we use blockchain technology to govern membership, voting, and our treasury. On top of that we are building a culture of distributed leadership and transparent experimentation to find the best ways to work together.

What’s the vision of Banyan DAO? Create a community that works together to learn web3 technologies and best practices, network with other entrepreneurial leaders, build products and services together, share in the decision making and value creation we enable.

What’s the mission of Banyan DAO? Our mission is to promote human flourishing by growing a community of entrepreneurial leaders.

Who are the members of Banyan DAO? Banyan DAO members represent every continent on the globe. Our decentralized approach allows members to contribute their professional gifts to projects based on their desired schedule while learning from others halfway around the world.

How was the DAOs name selected? Our name is Banyan DAO after the Banyan Tree, a plant that grows on another plant, when its seed germinates in a crack or crevice of a host tree or edifice. It then grows around the host tree until it finds roots in the ground, and then sends new roots down from extending branches to form a new trunk.

Name: YourCard
Description:
It’s been a short yet interesting journey. I am incredibly proud and incredibly disappointed.

I’m incredibly proud of our idea, the team effort and the reception and support it received from our supporters.

It may seem surprising that a seemingly well received product could fail, but it happens all the time. Although we arguably found product/market fit, we couldn’t quite crack the business side of things.

Building any business is hard, but bootstrapping a business is especially hard. I’ve come away with new found respect for those companies who are able to bootstrap successfully.

After encountering development hurdles that required additional funding, we attempted to raise funding and failed.

I’m terribly saddened that this spells the end for YourCard. As of today the team has gone their separate ways, and our doors are effectively closed.

I’m disappointed that I couldn’t produce a better outcome for those who supported YourCard. Few in business will know the pain of what it means to fail as a CEO. Not only do you fail yourself, but also your employees, partners, customers and supporters.

With that, I'd like to say to everyone who has been a part of this journey, from the bottom of my heart: Thank You.

Name: Non Malignant
Description:
Cancer shouldn't get a head start.

Non Malignant exists to fight one of cancer's most consequential problems: late detection.

Too often, people begin thinking seriously about cancer only after symptoms appear, someone close to them is diagnosed, or a routine examination raises a concern.

We believe the conversation should begin earlier.

Through cancer education, research, expert-led conversations, community initiatives and the development of early-detection solutions, we're working to help people understand cancer risk and appropriate screening before that information becomes urgent.

Our work is built around three beliefs:

Don't wait for symptoms to start learning.
Cancer awareness should begin before someone has a reason to fear cancer.

Know your risk before you need to.
Age, family history, genetics and other risk factors can influence the conversations people should have with qualified healthcare professionals.

Earlier action can create more options.
When clinically possible, detecting cancer earlier can materially change the choices available to patients and clinicians.

Non Malignant began with a deeply personal experience of late-stage breast cancer within our founding team. That experience turned one question into our mission:

What would healthcare look like if more people had the knowledge and tools to act earlier?

Today, we're working across awareness, research, community and technology toward that goal.

We don't believe every late diagnosis can be prevented. Some cancers remain difficult to detect early, effective screening is not available for every cancer, and access to healthcare remains a major barrier.

But wherever earlier action is possible, we believe people should have the knowledge to take it.

Late detection steals options.

Cancer shouldn't get a head start.

Name: New City Library
Description:
The New City Free Library was founded in 1936 and was originally housed in the New City School. Books were provided primarily by the school and by public donation. The library received $100 in state aid, and matching funds were raised by Library Committee bake sales, tea parties, book sales, and fashion shows.

In 1942, the New City Library Committee, "an unincorporated association of citizens" offered New City School District #5 the books it owned in an arrangement whereby the School Board would support the New City Free Library, and the Committee would continue to handle library business and select books.

By 1950 the school district could no longer support the library due to centralization and the need to convert the spaced used by the library into a classroom. A request was made to the Town Board of Supervisors for a $500 annual fee to support the library. A local attorney donated his legal services to incorporate the Library Committee as the New City Free Library Association, and applied for a charter with the State Education Department.

A provisional charter was obtained in 1951, along with a grant of $100. The library moved to the basement of the school while plans for a building went forward, paid for by contributions from the townsfolk, donated materials, and a charter membership fee to the library of five dollars. The New City Fire Department donated land on Maple Avenue.

In 1953 the library opened, financed primarily through yearly membership drives. The library was open twelve hours per week. 1956 saw the first discussions of obtaining library support from the taxpayers, and in 1958 a petition supporting tax support through the school district was adopted. The library's annual budget was $5,000.

Today the library is a modern facility serving nearly 50,000 people, in the communities of New City, Congers, and Bardonia, with a collection of about 170,000 volumes and a circulation of over one half million.

Your AI doesn't actually know you.
Sharedat is the personal knowledge graph that changes that.
Connect your data once — any agent can use it. Owned by you.

We treat privacy as something to earn, not to claim. Your documents are read by AI we run on our own infrastructure, so your raw files are never sent to a third-party model. Your most sensitive identity details — Social Security number, date of birth, address — are encrypted at rest with a key unique to you, and every read against your data is recorded in an activity log you can see. We tell you plainly what is protected today and what we are still building, rather than promising more than is true.

Underneath it all is a simple belief: you should own your data, and be able to control it — to decide who sees what, and to take it back. Think of it as a family office for your data: the tools the well-resourced have always used to organize and share information on their own terms, built for everyone else.

4. Specific Issues: A long text description of the exact bills and specific issues for which clients lobby on.

5. Bills Lobbied On: A parsed version of Specific Issues that catches specific HR, PL, and ACTS lobbied on (ex: H.R. 2347, S. 1117, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act).

6. Agencies Lobbied: The names of one or more of 250+ government agencies lobbied on in the contract (ex: White House, FDA, DOD).

7. Foreign Entities: The names and origin countries of entities affiliated with the client (ex: BNP Paribas: France).

Description:
Welcome to MyWhistleBox, the easiest and most convenient way to exchange business and personal content, privately and securely. MyWhistleBox was established to solve a common problem: how to securely share private information quickly, easily and affordably with 3rd parties. 

MyWhistleBox is different. With our proprietary Doubly-EncryptedTM approach to sharing documents, you can be assured that your confidential information is protected, and will only be viewed by your intended 3rd parties.  And it's very simple and easy to use too.

Today, email is cheap, easy and widely available. But did you know that email is not secure? Since its introduction in 1981, email is largely unchanged. Instead of encrypting messages before sending, most email is transmitted in plain text which means anyone with the means to intercept email messages can read it. Given today's challenges of securing people's Personally Identifiable Information (PII), why hasn't email kept up with the times? The short answer: encrypted email is harder to search and large search companies profit enormously from those searches. So sadly, don't expect anything to change anytime soon. 

Now to be fair, not all email needs to be safeguarded. Checking in with old friends, exchanging recipes, or sharing a funny joke doesn’t need rock solid security. But what about your financial records, government documents or medical records? Anything that is private should remain private and email is a very poor method of sharing that information. But millions do each and every day. And it's not safe nor wise. And in some cases, illegal.

So whether you're an individual looking for a safe and reliable way to share a few documents, or a business that needs to exchange content with many clients, start your free, no obligation Professional edition trial today and see for yourself.

Name: Idiomatic, Inc.
Description:
Idiomatic is Voice of Customer in a box, used by companies such as Pinterest, Instacart, and HubSpot. It can be used to build a voice of customer program or to look into automating an existing program.

With Idiomatic, customer feedback analysis can power the VOC to make changes that actually improve your Customer Experience. 

Idiomatic:
-Ingests your customer feedback from every data source.
-Automatically classifies the feedback so you don’t have to read every comment.
-Prioritizes feedback so you can focus on what matters.
-Summarizes and communicates that feedback to the parties who matter.

The solution aims to eliminate manual deep dives. Idiomatic pre-tags tickets for customer service routing. The customer feedback data types analyzed include helpdesk, surveys, app reviews, product reviews, social media, and forum/communities.

The biggest drawback we hear about other customer feedback analytics software is that they use general models are good at surfacing high-level themes, insights, and key phrases in text analysis, but are not tailored to give specific granular insights for each individual business or industry, taking into account language that is unique to you. This means that you still have to do deep dives to read lots of tickets to understand the specifics of what’s going on with a theme or phrase.

Idiomatic builds a new taxonomy unique to each client’s business that helps you better understand your customers and their specific feedback about your products and services. The Idiomatic models are not “theme” based, but use machine learning based on our taxonomy to better understand the relationship and meaning of your customer feedback. This means you can process high volumes of data at scale, and deliver specific human-understandable insights without requiring you to do deep dives to read lots of tickets to get actionable insights about your business.

Misr Technology Services (MTS) was awarded a contract with the Ministry of Finance to “enhance the current trade across borders system in Egypt using “Single Window” concept”. The project was code named “NAFEZA”.
NAFEZA System is a platform upon which an integrated set of business applications operates to automate & orchestrate import/export/transit cargo clearance activities from cargo arrival to cargo clearance using a “Single Window” concept. With the project extension to implement “Advance Cargo Information“ concept to control the importation process prior to loading shipments from the countries of export, NAFEZA System currently controls the importation process end-to-end.

In this regard, NAFEZA System represents the single point facility for Egyptian importers, exporters, brokers, shipping lines, and freight forwarders (Trade Community) to submit electronic data/documents and/or lodge data to Customs remotely in a secure manner. It also represents the only façade for communication between the Trade Community and the designated government authorities operating inside and/or outside the port (Government). This is achieved using online services on NAFEZA portal. Furthermore, NAFEZA provides customers services through a network of Logistic Services Centers which MTS established at the ports.

-Recruiters and talent teams sourcing from affected companies

-Anyone who believes you deserve to know about your own layoff first

Know before you're told.

Most employees find out they're losing their job the same day as everyone else. Layoff IQ changes that. By continuously tracking WARN Act data across 48 states, we surface early signals that give workers a critical head start to update their resume, activate their network, and land their next opportunity not scramble for it.

Additionally, the Department of Justice forwards Live Scan Fingerprints to the FBI (if required).


Who Needs Live Scan Anyway?


Real Estate Licensees, Notaries, DMV Licensed Professionals, Foster Parents, Stock Brokers, Teachers, Appraisers, Care Givers, Contractors, Security Guards, Nurses, Doctors, Surgeons, Volunteers, Etc...


What are the Benefits of Live Scan?


The Live Scan process helps in avoiding many of the problems associated with ink prints, such as smudging, smearing, and over or under inking. A major benefit of Live Scan is that your fingerprints are transmitted directly to the Department of Justice.

Name: DataScava
Description:
DataScava is an advanced unstructured text data mining solution that pinpoints high-quality data with user-controlled business and domain language.

It evolved from TalentBrowser, where we patented deterministic methods to structure, measure, filter, and curate nonlinear content — without requiring training data or manual labeling.

By enabling you to harness your expertise — working standalone or alongside other solutions — DataScava helps you:

* Structure, measure, filter, match, route, sort, and rank raw text automatically

* Feed explainable, auditable outputs into AI, LLMs, ML, RPA, BI, Research, TA, and BAU applications

* Create domain-specific data pipelines upstream, audit & measure results downstream

* Get structured, high-quality datasets and outputs you can act on

Stay in control with results you can see, refine, and trust

How It Works:

DataScava applies three complementary methodologies that focus on your business language and expertise, not generic language models:

DSIndex | DSLP | Domain-Specific Language Processing – Structures and measures user-defined key terms exactly, with no disambiguation

DSTopics | TTT | Tailored Topics Taxonomies – Import, build, or select vocabularies and data types that reflect your expertise

DSMatch | WTS | Weighted Topic Scoring – Prioritize outcomes with transparent, explainable scoring that reflects your rules and thresholds

Together, they form a patented approach we call “Profile Matching of Unstructured Documents” — modeled after a contour profile gauge carpentry tool, because DataScava measures language based on your priorities.

The DataScava Difference:

Less time, more accuracy – Filters and categorizes automatically
Precision at scale – Numeric results you can trust across industries

Transparency over black-box AI – See and audit exactly why a file matched
Scalable and domain-specific – Refine vocabularies, taxonomies, and scoring.

Human in Command – Automation works alongside your own expertise.

Name: Ten12
Description:
Ten12 is focused on difficult to price securities. We create investor consensus prices for 300,000+ securities by crowdsourcing prices from thousands of institutional investors. As such, unlike broker quotes, 100% of the prices used by Ten12 have a regulatory obligation for accuracy. 

Ten12’s Value Propositions:
 
•	Revalue a fund’s holdings using consensus prices to create a “peer” NAV that can be directly compared to a fund’s reported NAV.
 
•	Identify valuation outliers, including level II and III securities, that are driving the difference between a fund’s reported NAV and the fund’s revalued Peer NAV.
 
•	Focus internal valuation discussions on outliers (e.g., avoid prolonged discussions on non-outliers).
 
•	Protect against bias and fraud.
 
•	Change nothing. Ten12 is a cloud-based overlay to your current infrastructure. 

Each day Ten12 sees over 100,000 differences between institutional investors on the held price of the exact same security. Valuation risk is receiving increased regulatory attention. In December of 2020, the SEC enacted, what is described as the first comprehensive valuation rule in over 50 years. New SEC Rule 2a-5 requires a fund’s board to assess material valuation risks, and to evaluate any pricing service used. 

A great way to assess and evaluate anything is to compare it to others, and that is precisely what ten12 does. 

We compare a fund security prices to the prices of other institutional investors, lots and lots of other institutional investors. 

Although the new SEC rule only applies to public funds properly assessing valuation risk is a best practice for all funds, whether they are mutual funds, hedge funds or pension funds.

Name: Branding & Identity (Digital Marketing)
Description:
To understand branding, it is important to know what brands are. A brand is the idea or image of a specific product or service that consumers connect with, by identifying the name, logo, slogan, or design of the company who owns the idea or image. Branding is when that idea or image is marketed so that it is recognizable by more and more people, and identified with a certain service or product when there are many other companies offering the same service or product. Advertising professionals work on branding not only to build brand recognition, but also to build good reputations and a set of standards to which the company should strive to maintain or surpass. Branding is an important part of Internet commerce, as branding allows companies to build their reputations as well as expand beyond the original product and service, and add to the revenue generated by the original brand.

When working on branding, or building a brand, companies that are using web pages and search engine optimization have a few details to work out before being able to build a successful brand. Coordinating domain names and brand names are an important part of finding and keeping visitors and clients, as well as branding a new company. Coordination of a domain name and brand names lends identification to the idea or image of a specific product or service, which in turn lets visitors easily discovery the new brand.

Branding is also a way to build an important company asset, which is a good reputation. Whether a company has no reputation, or a less than stellar reputation, branding can help change that. Branding can build an expectation about the company services or products and can encourage the company to maintain that expectation, or exceed them, bringing better products and services to the marketplace.

What is Branding?
Branding is all of the ways you establish an image of your company in your customers’ eyes.

By building a website that describes what you offer, designing ads that promote your goods and services, selecting specific corporate colors that will be associated with your company, creating a logo, and featuring it across all your social media accounts, you are branding your company. That is, you are shaping how and what people’s perceptions of your business are.

And what your customers say about your brand is the reality (not what you’d like them to think). It’s the impression that pops into their minds when they hear your business’ name. It’s based on a feeling they have that is based on their experiences they’ve had with you, good or bad.

What’s the Point?
The purpose of branding is to simply and easily help your customers understand what you offer and how you’re different. But it’s not only a USP (unique selling proposition), it is the combination of all the ways you communicate what you stand for.

In addition to your logo and corporate colors, you can communicate your brand message through:

* Your store environment and atmosphere
* How your staff members treat customers
* How your staff members dress
* The products you carry
* The price you charge
* Product packaging
* Public relations
* Public speaking
* Direct mail
* Sponsorships
* Advertising
* Nonprofit partnerships
* What your customers and prospects take away from all this shapes your brand.

Building a Brand

Develop standards for employee dress and behavior that support your brand promise. Make sure they understand what your brand is and can support it.

Apply your visuals across every marketing tool you use, from advertising to signage to store displays to mailings to shopping bags.

Branding is a complex process, mainly because its success or failure is determined by your customers’ reactions to the act of doing business with you.

Description:
OGS Tracker is a free, citable registry of the world's optical ground stations, the telescopes that receive laser downlinks from space.

Optical downlink capacity is scaling faster than the ground segment that serves it. Roughly 830 optical ground stations are needed by 2035, and about 5% of that infrastructure exists today. The data on what does exist is scattered across conference papers, press releases and ITU filings, so we gather it into one place.

For every documented site, the registry records:

- Coordinates, altitude and the atmospherics that decide availability
- Aperture, adaptive optics, wavelengths and demonstrated data rates
- CCSDS standards spoken and links actually closed
- Who can book passes: agency, research or commercial
- The regulatory picture from licensing status to laser clearance and aviation coordination

Every entry cites its sources. Empty fields mean not yet documented, never zero. The inclusion methodology is published alongside the data, and operators can review and correct their own records.

Three commitments: no paywall, no login, and listing cannot be bought.

46 documented sites across 17 countries so far. The full database opens August 2026.

Operating a station we should have, or holding data we're missing? The contribute form is open at ogstracker.com.

隨著台北縣升格為新北市,台北縣電腦公會也同時升格為「新北市電腦公會」,即將被賦予更重要的使命與扮演更重要角色;回顧本會一路走來幾個重要的里程碑:從1987年創會以來扮演著資訊產業廠商的啟蒙角色與協助廠商處理專利等法律問題,使國內廠商與國際廠商開始進入平等式的合作關係;1995年到2000年著重在對ICT廠商的經貿服務,例如軟體工業五年計畫,連續5年春秋兩季皆帶領台灣軟體廠商至大陸三個主要城市進行交流與參訪;在公會悉心扶植下,台灣ICT產業羽翼漸豐之際,公會進而帶領著廠商邁開全球行銷的腳步,包括帶領廠商參加全球性的展覽、國際拓銷、出國考察等,並持續加強與大陸的交流。從2000年後,憑藉著國內IT產業技術的創新成熟,公會更進一步提供整合產業鏈之平台,發展新興產業,如智慧行動產業聯盟,及車載聯盟,對現今與未來的行動通訊及智慧生活提供廠商另一展試身手的機會。 
 
本會一直以來積極扮演政府與產業間的橋梁,做為整體產業升級成長的重要推手。因應ECFA時代來臨,政府正積極的推動兩岸產業合作與交流,公會亦努力創造兩岸產業合作平台,像是兩岸搭橋計畫的推動,及環渤海經濟圈的結盟與合作。2011年全球ICT產業成長主要動能將來自於新興和發展中國家,而台灣ICT產業也必須開始醞釀新的思維,去思考如何創造新的、對的商業模式與目標市場,中國大陸內需市場將會是未來幾年最大商機熱點之一。因此本會連結各縣市電腦公會成立了「台灣科技產業聯盟」,主要是結合各縣市有競爭力的中小企業,以ICT產業以及相關的產業、產品與服務為核心,努力推進兩岸企業的交流合作,進而帶動兩岸間的商機,創造兩岸產業雙贏。同時近幾年來為協助政府數位內容產業推廣計畫而成立「台北動漫聯盟」,以協助台灣數位內容產業國際拓銷,積極推動兩岸合作與推廣數位內容的產業國際化,也是公會近年來一直努力執行的政府政策與目標。
 
在此智慧城市萌芽時刻,本會除了繼續秉持二十多年來為台灣資通訊廠商服務與推動產業發展的熱情,更朝向「整合台灣與大陸的ICT產業,協助其產品智能化,進而為全球之智慧城市商機佈局」的展望與願景邁進!

Irrigator Technical Training School held tradeshows starting in 2003.  Richard Daigle had been in the Green Industry for 26 years and wanted individuals in our industry not to be forgotten. In 2009, Burt Sperber, Valley Crest Industries,  suggested to Richard that our awards ceremony at the fairgrounds  should be moved to a “nicer” location and suggested an evening event  in a restaurant. The Green Industry Awards are held yearly and honor inductees from many different divisions of the Green Industry.

United Ways of California, the state network of California’s United Ways, improves the health, education and financial results for low-income children and families by enhancing and coordinating the advocacy and community impact work of California’s United Ways. Name: OBR Optimization Engineering
Description:
OBR Optimization Engineering

Lean Six Sigma Systems Optimization
ERP Software Development
Quality Systems Enhancement
Business Process Improvement

The goal of business is to deliver optimal Return on Investment for company stakeholders.

The goal of Optimal Business Returns is to assist business entities to deliver optimal value to their internal and external customers while controlling operational costs to ensure maximum company return on investment. This is accomplished by improving operational efficiencies and eliminating process defects via control, innovation, and teamwork.

The use of Lean principles drives efficiency improvements while defect minimization is a focus of Six Sigma Variation Reduction. Control of systems is achieved with good management of the processes. Operational gains are a result of innovation and teamwork.

Questions:

1.) What is Lean? Lean principles describe systematic methodologies for eliminating waste from within a business processes. From the perspective of the business and, ultimately, the customer, waste can be defined as any action or process that does not add value to the final product or service. Value is any action or process for which the customer would be willing to pay. As business process waste is eliminated, the quality of the final product or service improves and production and service time and costs decrease. Lean systems include: Value Stream Mapping, Kanban Pull Systems, Kaizen Team Solutions, Scheduling, Work Cell Methodologies, Product & Service Work Flow, Maintenance Systems and Control Charts of Key Characteristics and Indicators.

2.) What is Six Sigma? Six Sigma is a set of tools and technologies for defect reduction in business processes. Six Sigma seeks to improve the quality output of the product or service offered by identifying and removing the causes of defects and minimizing the variability of the manufacturing and business systems. Six Sigma tools include: Experimental and Statistical Quality Methods that control production and service systems and reduce the causes of defects and the variation of those systems.

Enter Rezrov Lab’s first offering in development, the Calliope engine. Rezrov Lab builds creative AI by applying cutting edge deep learning methods to generate natural language data a three-step process:

Rezrov Lab is building Calliope as a B2C platform to generate its own new content as a marketable product. Our first commercial target is fiction — eBooks and articles. We look forward to completing our first implementation and perfecting an AI that helps us do what we’re best at — creativity.

Name: Halfbirthday.com
Description:
Of all the holidays, anniversaries and occasions we celebrate, there's one milestone gaining in popularity partly because it doesn't impose itself on us. Unless of course we want it to. 

It's the Half Birthday. An event we can pull out of our pocket whenever needed for any number of reasons, or totally ignore if we see fit with no one the wiser. 

For many, half birthdays are occasions of convenience. The discretionary semi-anniversary that's a win-win for those who choose to honor it and those happily on the receiving end.

Half birthdays originally grew out of a need to accommodate two groups: 

The first, infants and toddlers for whom a year is too long a wait to celebrate progress in their little lives. 

And second, those whose birthdays occur at inconvenient times of the year: during the holiday season when they're all but forgotten; in the summertime, when school children miss the inevitable classroom party; or at the height of winter when severe weather can put a damper on those who have always yearned for an outdoor birthday bash. 

In each of these circumstances, celebrating the half birthday is the perfect alternative, a Plan B that in some cases even becomes the permanent day of observance over the actual day of birth.

Now people are finding all sorts of additional reasons (excuses?) to break out the bubbly at the six-month mark. Some may balk that it's just another day to have to remember, plan, buy gifts for, and make a fuss over. 

But proponents counter that celebrating a half birthday is entirely optional, that it doesn't have to be a yearly event, and that no one, if they even know when their half birthday is, is expecting anything anyway. 

So no matter how you slice the cake, half birthdays are coming of age. They're here to stay. 

And Halfbirthday.com was created to serve all those who wish to celebrate them.

We recognize that the power of simple compassion and love in the midst of a culture that is bursting with tensions and unrest is an oasis to a generation being politically courted and relationally ignored.

All movements start small, but with your support, we believe hope can one day be afforded to every individual facing a pregnancy decision in our region. Today, we each have the opportunity to be the answer to the needs of those facing pregnancy decisions.

It’s communities that change communities. So whatever your role, be the hope in someone’s story.

AI Funnel Management

Most brands show up in AI search.

AIVO Optimize measures where your brand enters the AI buying conversation — and where it exits before the recommendation is made.

We run live, multi-turn buying sequences across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, and Claude. Not cached responses. Not scraped data. Real API calls at the moment of testing, three replicates per prompt, 95% statistical confidence.

The result is your CODA score — Conversational Outcome and Decision Analysis — the only metric that measures your buying recommendation win rate at the final step of an AI purchase conversation.

• Your CODA score (0–100) and which band you're in

The finding that defines this problem:

A brand can score 84/100 on AI visibility and have a buying recommendation win rate of zero. Both things are true simultaneously. Standard AI optimisation tools won't show you the gap. CODA will.

This is the AIVO Paradox. It's the most common pattern we observe across 160+ brands tested.

Visibility increases. Selection does not.

The Filter Taxonomy — the classification system identifying why brands are eliminated at the decision stage — is published as a peer-reviewed working paper on Zenodo (WP-2026-01, DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19401584, CC BY 4.0).

The result: millions of women carrying symptoms with no explanation, navigating a system that wasn't built with their biology in mind.
FemWiseIQ was built to close that gap — with the research that exists, honest about what's still missing.
We've built a clinical-grade research intelligence platform that synthesizes 100,000+ peer-reviewed studies — Cochrane Library, FDA DailyMed, WHO IRIS, NAMS Menopause Journal, NIH PubMed, DrugBank, and 6 additional clinical-grade sources — around a woman's specific conditions, symptoms, life stage, and medications.
Every source is scored using the GRADE clinical evidence framework, adapted to reflect the historical exclusion of women from research. We surface  Research Gap indicators where data is structurally absent — because knowing what the evidence doesn't cover yet is as important as knowing what it does.
What this means in practice:
When a woman asks why her ADHD medication stopped working, she gets a research-backed answer specific to her conditions, her cycle phase, her medications — with citations she can bring to her provider. Not a generic article. Not a hallucination. The actual science, synthesized for her situation.
For practitioners: FemWiseIQ is doctor-visit ammunition — research summaries, condition-aware pattern analysis, and lab interpretation in clinical context. A tool that makes your patients better informed and your appointments more efficient.
For partners and organizations: We are actively building partnerships with patient organizations, telehealth providers, and clinical researchers who share our commitment to closing the women's health intelligence gap.
For builders and investors: This is a data infrastructure play built by a 20-year data platform architect. Clinical-grade from day one. Privacy by design.

Countermeasures scored. A decision brief with a viability verdict. Works on any device. Works offline. No account required to view it.
The conversation ends. The analysis stays.
MAIA runs as a standalone Enterprise App hosted on Cloudflare, powered by direct Anthropic API integration. Your data never leaves the session. Zero data retention by design.

Name: AIVO Journal
Description:
AIVO Journal explores how AI assistants shape brand visibility, customer choice, and enterprise risk. As general-purpose models begin to influence procurement, product discovery, competitive analysis, and financial interpretation, organizations face a new governance problem: external AI systems increasingly define how they are represented.

We analyse this shift through a governance lens, not a marketing one. Our work examines:
• How reasoning drift in models leads to inconsistent or incorrect descriptions
• How substitutions alter competitive positioning
• How hallucinated certifications and claims create legal and financial exposure
• How visibility losses in assistants can translate into revenue at risk
• How enterprises can monitor, evidence, and govern these behaviours

Every piece published in the Journal is grounded in structured testing across major assistants, reproducible evidence bundles, and clear attribution of change to model behaviour. We avoid speculation and focus on observable patterns.

Our audience spans CMOs, CFOs, Chief Risk Officers, data leaders, and governance teams who need to understand how AI assistants influence decisions long before formal processes begin. The aim is not to promote tools or prescribe compliance frameworks, but to surface the dynamics that matter and provide decision-makers with clarity on how assistant-mediated environments are evolving.

If your organization relies on customer trust, regulated disclosures, or digital visibility, the reasoning behaviour of external AI systems is now part of your risk surface. AIVO Journal exists to make that surface visible.

The breach doesn't bankrupt you. The denied claim does.

Cybantage is a research-driven cybersecurity advisory practice serving healthcare, financial services, and government contractors — the regulated industries where a cyber event doesn't just disrupt operations. It triggers insurance scrutiny, regulatory investigation, and leadership accountability reviews that determine whether an organization survives or doesn't.

Most organizations believe that compliance certification protects them. HITRUST. SOC 2. CMMC. These frameworks measure control maturity. They do not measure adversarial resilience. And cyber insurance carriers — who pay claims based on defensibility, not certification — know the difference.

We built Cybantage around that gap.

Our flagship framework, the Cyber Insurance Survivability Index (CISI), scores organizations across 10 domains — identity governance, endpoint control, backup integrity, logging and detection, incident response, third-party risk, policy alignment, data classification, and coverage gap exposure. The result is a survivability score that reflects what your insurer will evaluate at the moment of claim, not what your last audit said.

The CISI is the foundation of the Cybantage Cyber Survivability Framework — a structured five-stage engagement model that takes organizations from scored exposure through legal protection, forensic verification, and sustained survivability posture.

Our published research corpus — including Healthcare Breach Survivability (1,478-provider dataset), The Compliance-Insurance Illusion, HITRUST: Certification Assurance and Its Limits, and SOC 2: Governance Assurance and Its Limits — forms the empirical basis for everything we do.

Cybantage is based in Spring Hill, Tennessee. We serve clients directly in healthcare and financial services, and through a licensed partner network in government contracting, manufacturing, and international markets.

The Keller Maps were compiled primarily between the 1930s and 1950s, with sporadic, limited updates continuing through the early 2010s. These hand-drawn sheets document farm owners, wells, operators, and community landmarks such as schools and churches. With 273 individual maps, each covering five minutes of latitude and longitude, they remain the only commercially available oil and gas farm maps of western Kentucky.

Today, the archive is being systematically digitized, georeferenced, and enhanced to make it more accessible and relevant. Name: ESG-news.online
Description:
Die Gesellschaft fordert von Unternehmen zunehmend mehr Transparenz über die Auswirkungen ihres unternehmerischen Handelns auf Menschen und Umwelt. ESG-Kommunikation hat sich daher von einer Kür zum Pflichtbestandteil in der Unternehmenskommunikation entwickelt. Dies gilt insbesondere für die Finanzwirtschaft und für kapitalmarktorientierte Unternehmen.

Investoren auf der ganzen Welt sind auf der Suche nach geeigneten Anlagen. BlackRock-Chef Larry Fink erinnert in seinem CEO-Letter regelmäßig daran, dass die Trendwende gekommen ist und der größte Asset Manager der Welt bereits damit begonnen habe, sein Portfolio umzustellen. Eine Analyse von PWC Luxemburg über alle Assetklassen hat in einer Befragung von 200 Asset-Managern, 300 institutionellen Investoren und 800 Retail-Investoren herausgearbeitet, dass 77 % der Investoren in den nächsten zwei Jahren den Non-ESG-Investments den Rücken kehren wollen.

Viele Unternehmen haben bereits weitreichende Commitments zum Klimaschutz abgegeben, aber sie müssen nicht nur Nachhaltigkeitsverantwortung bekennen, sondern darüber berichten.

Transparenz und ESG-Berichterstattung wird zentralen Bestandteil der Kapitalmarktkommunikation. Es entsteht ein erheblicher Professionalisierungsdruck für die betroffenen Unternehmen und Ausbildungsbedarf für Mittarbeiter der IR- und PR-Abteilungen. In diesem Markt wollen viele Berater und Dienstleister mitspielen. Sie suchen nach Plattformen, um sich ihren potenziellen Kunden präsentieren zu können. Gleichzeitig befindet sich die ESG-Strategie und -Kommunikation in vielen Unternehmen noch in der Frühphase. Bei Entscheidungsträgern und Kommunikationsverantwortlichen besteht ein hoher Informationsbedarf über die Entwicklung des gesetzlichen Rahmens, Best Practices, etc.

Mit ESG-News wollen wir in diesem Umfeld eine unabhängige Nachrichten- und Informationsplattform bieten, die der professionellen ESG-Community als zentraler Anlaufpunkt für Know-how-Austausch dient.

Name: Clark County Library
Description:
The Clark County Library is one of the oldest library buildings in Arkansas, and is representative of early efforts to establish libraries in the state. On November 11, 1897, about thirty Arkadelphia women banded together to form the Woman's Library Association. Their goal was to establish a public library in Arkadelphia, and within six years this goal was achieved. The vision of these determined women was translated into the brick and mortar of a beautiful public building.
The Woman's Library Association began its collection of books with donations from members and local citizens. The books were stored in the association president's home, and later moved to rent-free space downtown. By 1899 the Association was forced to rent space for its book collection. At this time the library building fund began.
Through money-raising events such as oyster suppers, bazaars, spelling bees, and fiddlers' contests, about $1,000.00 was raised. In 1903, a loan was secured and construction of a library building began. During the ten years following its opening, money-raising activities continued to pay off the library building loan. The most significant event occurred in 1905 when William Jennings Bryan gave a benefit lecture for the library. By 1913 the debt was fully paid.  
Designed by architect Charles L. Thompson of Little Rock, the library was built by James Pullen. An oversized portico with ionic columns mark the facade of this one-story red brick structure. The Clark County Library was completed in 1903, and remains intact today as an example of early twentieth century institutional architecture in Arkansas.
Throughout its history the Clark County Library has served other than just the academic needs of the Arkadelphia community. It has often been used for recitals, by church and civic groups, and for public meetings. During World War I it was converted to a Red Cross workshop filled with cutting tables and sewing machines.
From its 1903 opening until 1939, the library was owned and operated by the Woman's Library Association; however, in the latter year, the building and its contents were donated to the city. In 1974 the deed was transferred to the Clark County Library Board, enabling the library to better server the entire county. It was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1974.

Description:
Maalexi is building the foundational infrastructure for real-world asset (RWA) exchange in global agricultural trade — engineered from physical execution, not abstraction. This is not a layer on broken systems; it is the replacement for them. 

The problem is structural: SMEs that produce and move the majority of the world’s food cannot access financing because no bank can reliably verify their inventory, contracts, or counterparties. Maalexi solves this by transforming fragmented commodity flows into transparent, auditable, and finance-ready trade assets. 

The platform combines AI-driven trade intelligence, IoT-based asset monitoring, and blockchain-enforced settlement to verify commodities across storage and transit, dynamically price risk, score counterparties, and execute legally binding contracts in real time. 

The system is already live, with real transactions, verified inventory, and operational warehousing across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Europe, and India. On-chain settlement finality is being advnaced on Avalanche blockchain, making every trade transparent, auditable, and settlement-final. 

Maalexi’s key goal is to deliver MAATEX, the world’s first regulated public RWA agricultural exchange, where tokenized agricultural commodities trade fast, in a derisked environment with instant settlement like the regulated and public commodity exchanges, backed by verified physical assets.

Utes & Alexanders #CatchUpCall - Inspirationen, Insights, Impulse 
10 Experten á 5 Minuten auf den Punkt

Wir geben im CatchUpCall echten Experten eine Bühne und damit die Möglichkeit, Ihrer Zielgruppe ganz professionell und sympathisch zu zeigen,

 wer sie sind, 
 was sie ausmacht und 
 was der besondere "Wow-Effekt in der Zusammenarbeit mit ihnen ist. 

Das Format richtet sich an Geschäftsführer, Entscheider und Führungskräfte auf Managementebene mittelständischer Unternehmen.

Die Story hinter dem Format:
Die Idee, ein Liveformat namens CatchUpCall ins Leben zu rufen, schlummerte schon einige Monate bei Alexander Niggemann in der Schublade. Von Anfang an war klar, dass er diese Idee mit einem Partner umsetzen wollte. Hin und wieder startete er in Gesprächen mit interessanten Persönlichkeiten den Versuch, eine Partner*in zu gewinnen. Doch es fehlte der Kick und die spürbare Begeisterung beim Gegenüber.

Nach einer Podcast-Aufnahme kam er mit seinem Interviewgast, Ute Gütschow, ins Gespräch über LinkedIn, Sichtbarkeit und Liveformate. 
Als Ute voller Begeisterung eines ihrer Zitate verlauten ließ: „LinkedIn ist eine wunderbare Bühne und wir sind die Akteure, die darauf spielen dürfen“, machte es Klick. Beide hatten plötzlich dieselbe Vorstellung von einem großen Theater im Kopf, von einem Saal mit sehr vielen Zuschauern und nur wenigen Akteuren, die auf der Bühne etwas zum Besten gaben. 

Da war er endlich! Dieser magische Moment der Begeisterung eines Menschen, der genau wie Alexander selbst, Freude daran hat, anderen eine Bühne zu geben. Die Geburtsstunde des Catch Up Calls! 

Nun galt es, 10 geeignete Experten zu motivieren, sich der Herausforderung zu stellen, in nur 5 Minuten live ihr Thema kurz und knackig auf den Punkt zu bringen. 

17 Tage später war es dann auch schon soweit. Die Premiere des ersten #CatchUpCalls ging an den Start und wurde im Live und in der Nachschau 675 Mal angeschaut!

Name: TiNT
Description:
TiNT brings tech ed and opportunities to therapists, and clinical credibility to mental health products.

Our premise is this: mental health practitioners are systematically left out of the rooms where the tools meant to serve their field get built. That absence cuts both ways. For the industry, it means products built without the clinical judgment that makes them trustworthy, showing up as low adoption, low retention, and high churn. For therapists, it means no real stake in an industry that's reshaping their profession around them, and no sustainable income beyond service hours, without which they burn out and leave the field, worsening the exact access gap those tools were supposed to fix.

TiNT exists to close both gaps at once: bring therapists into mental health innovation, and give them fair, reliable income from it.

TiNT Academy runs the flagship course Applied Product Thinking for Therapists, a hands-on program that teaches practicing clinicians to think like builders and how to engage with the tools showing up in mental healthcare as users, evaluators, collaborators, and critics, and not just downstream recipients. The Academy also prepares therapists to evolve their practice for a changing clinical landscape, including how to recognize and respond to clients' AI-related issues, and building AI psychoeducation into everyday clinical work.

TiNT Studio is the consulting arm. We place therapists directly inside startups, through recruiting or short-term projects, so founders and technologists get structured clinical perspective, and therapists get paid work that isn't more service hours.

Working both sides of the ecosystem means TiNT gets therapists and builders speaking the same language, and gives clinicians a strong stake, income, and voice, in how mental health technology gets shaped.

Our Mission: 
Citizens for Criminal Justice Reform works for a just, humane, and restorative judicial and correctional system by means of research, public education, legislative advocacy, coalition building, community organizing, and litigation. We support rational, cost-effective programs and policies that reduce crime, lower recidivism, and make our society safer.

Our Vision: 
CCJR seeks a system of justice that protects the community while promoting the rehabilitation of offenders and the well-being of inmate families.

Our Goals:
- Build, empower, and mobilize an active statewide coalition. 
- Debunk common myths and stereotypes about prison and offenders. 
- Reform the criminal justice process to make it more restorative and less adversarial. 
- Promote alternatives to incarceration which are less costly and more effective than prison, such as fines, counseling, community service, and restitution. 
- Advocate for programs that maintain relationships between inmates and their loves ones. 
- Work to reintegrate offenders back into their families and communities. 
- Address addiction as a healthcare issue, not as a criminal offense, and redirect resources to prevention and treatment. 
- Oppose mandatory minimum sentences and dangerous overcrowding in our jails and prisons. 
- Serve as a networking resource for prisoners and their families.

Description:
LexisNexis는 1966년에 Data Corporation로서 설립되고, 그 후 1968년에 The Mead Corporation 산하 기관으로 편입되었습니다. 1994에 Reed Elsevier plc 가 LexisNexis Group를 매수해 세계 수의 출판업자/정보 제공업체로서의 지위를 구축하고 있습니다.

LexisNexis Group의 본부는 미국 오하이오주 데이톤에 위치하며 세계 각국에 약 13,000명의 종업원이 있습니다. 미국의 약 50개 도시 및 럽, 아시아 등 세계 각지에 영업 거점을 설립하고 있습니다.
LexisNexis 그룹은 창업 이래 정보업계의 개척자로서 매진하고 있습니다. 1973년에 LEXIS 서비스 투입으로 온라인 검색 분야를 개척했습니다. LEXIS 서비스란 최초의 풀 텍스트 상용 법률 정보 온라인 서비스로 법률 전문가가 법률 정보를 보다 효율적으로 조사할 수 있도록 설계된 것입니다.
한편 NEXIS 서비스는 1979년에 뉴스 및 비즈니스에 관련된 광범위한 정보를 수집, 사업화되었습니다.

LexisNexis 그룹의 정보 서비스는 온라인, 인터넷, CD-ROM, 출판물 등의 매체를 통해 60개국 이상에서 수많은 고객(법률, 비즈니스, 정부, 미디어, 학술 기관 등)이 이용하고 있습니다.
Butterworths, Les Editions du Juris Classeur, Martindale-Hubbell등 저명한 법률 관련 출판업자도 LexisNexis 그룹의 일각을 담당하고 있습니다.

This 'country' is thriving, attracting business people, students, educators, medical professionals and many other professionals who are highly driven, socially aware and ‘global’ in their outlook. 

Expatland began as a book, written in 2015 by John Marcarian. Through travelling extensively and working with expat clients in his role at CST Tax Advisors, John developed an awareness of the issues expats face when heading to a new country. Designed to be an ‘expat survival guide’, the book delivers solid advice, statistics and a step-by-step plan for smooth integration. Its mission is to help expats embrace the opportunity to live and work overseas, eliminating difficulties that might trigger a premature return to their country of origin.

The Expatland book was just the start. To solve the problem of lack of support for would-be expats, John has launched ‘E-Teams’. The concept, developed based on research using data from the World Bank, the OECD and the International Labour Organisation, is to provide a proactive solution to the problems faced by ‘unsupported expats’ on the move. Through one point of contact, expats can access help anywhere.

E-Teams bring together vetted professionals on the ground in a wide range of international locations, who can deliver the types of services needed by expats. Operating at a city level, they have essential local knowledge and insight. They cut through complexity and drill down to the issues that are relevant to specific locations.

E-Teams are lending their specialist knowledge to refresh and update the Expatland book, writing free-to-download chapters packed with locally-focused advice, tips and case studies.

Name: pumsdata.com
Description:
PUMSdata makes U.S. Census Bureau microdata usable by anyone — no spreadsheets, no APIs, and no data-science background required.

The American Community Survey's Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) is one of the richest sources of demographic, economic, and housing data in the United States. It's also notoriously hard to use: raw records and sample-weight math put it out of reach for most of the people who'd benefit from it. PUMSdata turns it into a point-and-click tool.

Explore over 100 statistics such as income, housing, education, employment, commuting, health coverage, and more for every U.S. state and 2,462 neighborhood-scale areas also known as Public Use Microdata Area or PUMA. Build custom population segments in a guided query builder, (think "renters aged 25–34 with a bachelor's degree"), view results as interactive maps and tables, compare years, and export to CSV or Excel in one click.

Every figure is a properly survey-weighted estimate and is computed with the ACS sample weights, not a raw sample count to ensure data integrity.

Built for market researchers, economists, policy and urban planners, journalists, real-estate and site-selection teams, nonprofits, and anyone who needs reliable local demographic data without standing up a data project.

PUMSdata is an independent product, not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Census Bureau. The underlying data is in the public domain.

Explore it at pumsdata.com.

Agents can already write, test, and deploy code with minimal human oversight. That's not a future state. That's happening now.

Our name says what we do. Stabilis is Latin for stable, steady, enduring, and IQ is intelligence — together, Stability through Intelligence.

StabilisIQ delivers continuous operational stability for mid-market and enterprise organizations. We act as an operator-of-record for the systems and processes your business can't afford to have fail — building a custom solution around your environment, not a fixed product.

Every organization has a short list of operational problems that carry real consequences: the handoff that quietly breaks, the workflow that degrades under load, the after-hours gap no one owns, the process that works "most of the time." These rarely announce themselves. They accumulate silently and surface at the worst moment — at quarter close, during an audit, or after customers and revenue have taken the hit.

StabilisIQ exists to take those problems off your plate — and keep them solved.

Most clients start with a focused, custom engagement — a specific problem stabilized, a critical gap closed. From there, many move to continuous operator-of-record coverage as we take on more of what keeps their operation stable.

We're not a consulting firm and not a software vendor. We don't hand over recommendations and walk away — we assume ongoing, hands-on responsibility for the outcome: after-hours monitoring, cross-system visibility, silent-failure detection, incident escalation, and direct intervention when stability is at risk.

The result is predictable operations leadership can trust — fewer surprises, controlled risk, credible reporting, and stable execution.

Stability through Intelligence — engineered for your business, continuously maintained.

Name: Signal Scope
Description:
Signal Scope provides independent deal-risk intelligence for sales leaders managing complex enterprise opportunities.

Enterprise deals rarely fail with a clear “no.” More often, they stall quietly after verbal alignment when procurement, security review, risk assessment, or internal approval processes take over. These breakdowns are difficult to see inside a CRM, yet they are often what determine timing, confidence, and outcome.

Signal Scope exists to clarify those moments.

Each assessment delivers a concise, executive-ready Deal Intelligence Dossier that examines buyer-side approval dynamics, prioritization signals, funding durability, and internal coordination risks that standard pipeline reviews frequently miss. The focus is not on sales performance, product fit, or relationship strength, but on whether a deal is structurally positioned to move forward or operating with unresolved visibility constraints.

Signal Scope is designed for situations where forecast confidence matters, internal pressure is rising, and leadership needs an objective basis for decision-making. Assessments are completed independently, without meetings, software, or ongoing engagement, and are delivered within 24–48 hours.

This service is most often used by enterprise and cybersecurity sales leaders when a deal appears active but progress feels uncertain, approval paths are opaque, or timing risk is increasing late in the cycle.

Signal Scope does not coach, enable, or optimize sales teams.
It provides independent judgment, grounded in deal structure, approval mechanics, and buyer-side reality.

Name: The '89er Trail
Description:
The '89er Trail

Sharing the Story of Oklahoma City's Birth
At high noon on a bright and clear Monday, April 22, 1889, a drama roared to life when mounted soldiers fired their guns and blew their bugles to signal that the Land Run of 1889 was on. An estimated 50,000 people began the race from the perimeter boundaries of Oklahoma Territory's Unassigned Lands.

By the end of the day, settlers had staked out claims for the townsite known as "Oklahoma Station" better known today as Oklahoma City. Those first few months of the city's birth witnessed land disputes between Boomers and legitimate settlers, lot jumping triggered by competing land surveys, duels between leading citizens, and incredible perseverance.

The '89er Trail brings history alive with historical markers placed at the actual site the events took place. As you take this walk through history, listen to the story of Oklahoma City's birth on your mobile device. Each marker is your gateway to learn even more with links to additional stories, photos and podcasts.

Description:
Braincat is a web-based application that helps people think better. It's especially useful for:

Writing;
Brainstorming;
Planning & strategy;
Study & research;
Design & creative thinking;
Managing your daily life.


Braincat is based on a simple process comprising three steps:

1. INPUT
2. ORGANIZE
3. OUTPUT

The key to this process is that you can pour everything into the hopper without having to structure it first. This is relaxing when you're taking notes in a meeting, or studying lots of different materials, or you're bursting with ideas.

CATEGORIES SIMPLIFY
Braincat makes it easy to distill your input by grouping it in categories, which you then place in a sequence. The categories give you a quick, short-hand map of the territory. They are organic to your material because you made them — so you know what they mean.

THE BIG IDEA
In Braincat, you're encouraged to step back and ask yourself, "What's the big idea?"  You capture it in a few words, and now you have a guiding principle moving forward.

MANY WAYS TO OUTPUT
Braincat gives you different ways to view and output your organized material. You get an outline and a mind map. You can export the material as a CSV file, which can then be used Google Sheets or Excel.

TEXTBREAKER: AN EXTRA GEM
You can input blocks of text into Braincat, copied from any source. A function called TextBreaker(TM) breaks the text into phrases, which you can then categorize and sequence as you need. 

MORE FUNCTIONS TO COME
A major upgrade of Braincat is underway, and there will be many more new tools appearing over the next few months. Watch this space!

Meanwhile, you can experience Braincat for yourself at:

https://thebraincat.com/

And you're welcome to contact us here for more information.

Expanding on that simple concept he, along with some like minded friends, created Adiyvo.

Zite is an integrated platform to help teams and organizations manage and monitor projects or programs with multiple, distributed work sites. Through our mobile app and web platform, Zite integrates data about all aspects of a project or program, from early assessments, to implementation, to operations and maintenance. Zite helps teams collaborate better, integrating information and communication to improve quality, manage resources, and improve planning and decision making. 

We started working on digital field monitoring tools after the 2015 Nepal Earthquakes. Across Nepal, more than 1 million structures were damaged, and rebuilding them required building more seismically resilient buildings throughout mountainous and hard-to-reach locations. Zite builds on the findings and lessons we learned working with the government, charities, and the UN in trying to use mobile technology to improve the delivery of quality services. 

We are excited to launch Zite to help people deliver quality projects — wherever they are. We believe that quality projects are the basis of economic and social development, and we are excited to work with partners to help them deliver projects that lead to a more just and resilient future.

Name: Measuring Carbon
Description:
Carbon emission data is critical for tackling climate change and meeting net-zero goals. But drawing insights from emissions data can be complicated. We are building tools to analyze carbon data in an easy and accessible manner.

Satellite data can directly measure carbon emissions at high spatial and temporal resolutions. However, the data is in silos, and researchers need significant expertise to derive insights that enable decision-making. 

This is where Measuring Carbon comes in. We collate satellite measurements of carbon emissions from disparate sources and link them to other observables such as land use, land cover, wildfires, and urban build-up. Our open data platform allows public audits of carbon emissions at high spatial and temporal resolutions.

Name: Association for Science in Autism Treatment (ASAT)
Description:
The Association for Science in Autism Treatment (ASAT) is a not-for-profit organization run by an all-volunteer board of 15 professionals, many of whom are parents of children and adolescents with autism. ASAT is committed to improving the education, treatment, and care of people with autism. Since autism was first identified, there has been a long history of failed treatments and fads levied on vulnerable families. ASAT was the first autism advocacy group to explicitly embrace an empirical, science-based approach to any statements made about the causes and proposed treatments for autism. Before ASAT was formed in 1998, the major autism advocacy groups considered themselves to be “the leading source of trusted and reliable information about autism.” In reality, they were not evaluating or offering any guidance about the array of treatment options being introduced year after year. It has always been ASAT’s hope to work toward the adoption of higher standards of accountability in the way that people with autism are cared for, educated, and treated. It remains our goal to assure that the family of every person with autism has access to information that will help them access the best intervention that science can provide, delivered with competence and compassion.
 
The first issue of ASAT’s newsletter, Science in Autism Treatment, was published in 1999. Since initial publication, the newsletter has provided consumers with accurate information about science-based autism treatments in a language that is easy to understand. The newsletter was published free-of-charge for three years to ensure that everyone had access to accurate, helpful information. In 2001, ASAT’s website (www.asatonline.org) was launched to increase the reach of our information through suggested reading lists, web-based links, and key articles on autism and its treatments.
 
The last few years have been particularly important for ASAT.  We are now comprised of committees and an Externship program, each with their own distinct yet complementary purpose and goals. We resumed publication of our quarterly newsletter in the summer of 2009 and continue to distribute to almost 13,000 recipients in all 50 states and 100 countries around the world. In many respects the newsletter has become more comprehensive and multifaceted than the original publication format. We have also continued to expand and upgrade our website with resources that are more accessible and user-friendly. ASAT has developed specific pages for distinct groups including the media, pediatricians, parents of newly-diagnosed children, parents of older children and adults, and teaching faculty. We have developed mechanisms to productively engage dozens of volunteers within our organizational structure. 
ASAT remains one of the foremost voices for the dissemination of science-based information about autism and its treatment, while promoting greater access to credible, effective, and safe treatments.

Name: PA 211
Description:
If you need to connect with resources in your community, but don’t know where to look, PA 211 is a great place to start. From help with a utilities bill, to housing assistance, after-school programs for kids, and more, you can dial 211 or text your zip code to 898-211 to talk with a resource specialist for free. Our specialists will listen to your needs, and give you information on programs in your community that might be able to help.

Visit pa211.org to search for services available in your community by categories such as financial assistance, housing, and food.

What is 211? 
211 is a vital service leveraged by millions of people across North America. Every day, clients contact 211 to access free and confidential crisis and emergency counseling, disaster assistance, food, health care and insurance assistance, stable housing and utilities payment assistance, employment services, veteran services and childcare and family services.

What Does 211 Do?
No matter the situation, the specialists at 211 listen, identify underlying problems, and connect people in need with resources and services in their community that improve their lives. In 2019 alone, PA 211 answered more than 200,000 calls, connecting community members in need to life-changing support.

Why Does 211 Matter?
211 does more than “patch people through” to agencies. Instead, 211 specialists are trained to identify root causes of a client’s problem – and connect them with a wide range of available resources that meet all the underlying needs, not just the one that prompted the call or text.

No other program has its “finger on the pulse” of America’s greatest needs. It’s a vital part of United Way’s efforts to build stronger communities and fight for the health, education and financial stability of every person in every community. 211 makes the social services ecosystem/network more efficient by ensuring people in need are connected to agencies that can help them.

Name: Gadget Software
Description:
We are the architects of Compute-Ready Data. 

As the industry shifts from an Access Economy to an Answers Economy, unstructured documents like PDFs remain the biggest barrier to reliable AI. Standard practices like blind chunking lead to context collapse and hallucinations. Gadget Software solves this by operationalizing the Knowledge Object through our TopicLake Insights Engine (TIE).

Our Technology: The Semantic Twin

TIE replaces arbitrary chunking with Agentic Ingestion to create a Semantic Twin of your data.

* Semantic Decomposition: We break documents by topic boundaries rather than word count to preserve original meaning.
* Synthetic Enrichment: The engine generates pre-computed Q&A pairs and summaries for high-precision matching.
* Entity Intelligence: We build structured indices of people, places, and events to facilitate complex queries.
* Inherited Governance: Security classifications and citation lineage are embedded at the topic level to ensure data sovereignty.

Verified Performance: The Signal65 Report

Third-party testing by Signal65 confirms that TIE, running on-premise with Dell PowerEdge servers and Broadcom networking, outperforms cloud-based RAG alternatives.

* A Flatter Latency Curve: We deliver deterministic, low-latency processing that remains stable even as document complexity scales.
* Data Sovereignty: Organizations maintain total control over sensitive or regulatory data by keeping it entirely on-premise.
* Sustainability: Our Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) architecture reduces energy consumption by pre-computing reasoning once and serving it as a shared utility.

Our Mission

From modernizing the U.S. Federal Register to preparing Scholarly Publishers, and enabling any enterprise for the AI era, Gadget Software provides the connective tissue for complex knowledge. Don't just manage files. Engineer knowledge.

The Georgia Center for Employee Ownership (GACEO) is a nonprofit organization whose mission is to improve the economic lives of workers in the state of Georgia by educating business owners, their advisors, local government, and other community stakeholders about the social impact and business benefits of employee ownership.  

Employee ownership is many things. For selling owners, it is a powerful way to establish the legacy of their business and keep their workers employed in the community where the business is located. Multiple research studies have shown that most companies that become employee-owned see higher revenue and profits after the transition to employee ownership and certain tax advantages can allow a business owner to receive a competitive return on the sale of their business.

For workers, employee ownership can help build wealth and retirement savings. It can also foster employee engagement and a spirit of shared stewardship in their company, especially when combined with participatory management systems and financial education. 

The main challenge with creating more employee owned companies is simple awareness. According to the Exit Planning Institute, only 30% of companies have a written succession plan, and only 6% consider employee ownership as part of that plan. We believe that entrepreneurs, workers, and communities across the state of Georgia will benefit from learning about employee ownership.  To help with this education we will schedule free workshops with anyone who wants to learn more about the how and why of a transition to an employee owned business model.   You can also contact us directly for a free consultation and assessment.

The Centre is currently involved in the development of spatial databases for mapping land use and land cover changes, desertification and flood hazards. IEEE began as an organization founded and led by some of the leading industrial figures of the time. It is imperative that IEEE reconnect with those driving the advancement of technology in industry and entice these valued professionals back into our community. IEEE is at its best when we bring together the totality of our offerings with the rich diversity of our global community of professionals from academia, government, and industry to solve the problems facing humanity. 
These past few years have seen great strides in IEEE’s efforts to engage with industry, coupled with an urgency to provide technical professionals the tools and information they need to excel.

www.RockyMountainADA.com

1.	Answers to Questions - The ADA Center staffs a toll-free phone line, weekdays from 9 am - 4 pm MT. The Center's information specialists can answer most questions about the ADA immediately and will research more complex questions if necessary. 
2.	Training - The ADA Center offers basic to advanced level seminars and workshops on the ADA and other related disability laws.
3.	Materials - The ADA Center stocks a selection of current information on the ADA.

Comprising of some of the top young people in tech in Ireland, the  Youth Council aims  to give a voice to young people involved in technology in Ireland and provide them with a platform to influence the National Digital Strategy, and the future of technology in education There are currently twelve members of the Youth Council, listed here www.digitalyouthcouncil.com which will be the main body of the movement.

HerStoryTelling began as a blog series and has evolved since 2021 as a way to find and share our voices. We uncovered the buried rebel that lives in every woman, the voice yearning to be let out, a voice which is always suppressed because it’s “too loud,” “too opinionated,” “too BITCHY...”

We are NOT “too angry!” We’re simply fed up, and who wouldn’t be if they were constantly told that insults and disrespect was intended as compliments, that we need to own other people’s shit because “that’s what women do,” that setting boundaries for how others treat us is unacceptable. We’ve found that blowing through THOSE boundaries that society sets and establishing our own is the highest form of self-love there is, and it’s allowed us to embrace all aspects of being women - from the feminine to the badass - because that’s who we are.

For us, it’s been an enlightening evolution...and we want to empower other women to lean into their own version of femininity - whatever that means for them personally! So, we created this space in hopes of building a community of women who will join us on this authentic journey as we learn more about the women who came before us and share their multi-faceted, layered experiences that have impacted the world (and us) more than we ever imagined. We want to honor those who came before us, empower those who are here with us and and inspire those who come after us - and we hope you accompany us as we venture into HerStoryTelling!

I wasn’t born into entrepreneurship—I built it with my own two hands. Growing up in Wisconsin, I learned the value of hard work from my family. Over 27 years ago, I moved to Arizona to chase opportunity and began working for the largest residential landscaping company in the state. It looked like I had it all figured out, but the truth was, I was learning on the fly. Behind the scenes, I was juggling cash flow issues, managing a team without systems, and figuring out how to price jobs profitably. Every mistake became a lesson, and every challenge pushed me to find better solutions. Over time, I developed systems that transformed my business from chaotic to controlled.  

These systems became the foundation for helping others. Fellow business owners started seeking me out, and what began as casual advice turned into a passion. Since then, I’ve dedicated my life to helping service-based business owners—landscapers, roofers, HVAC pros, and more—build businesses they’re proud of. From generating over $20 million in revenue to mentoring owners who reclaimed their time, I’ve seen how systems change lives.  

I’m not just a mentor; I’m in the trenches daily. I know the grind—and I know how to break free, because I’ve done it myself.

Home Inspection: A home inspection is an objective visual examination of the physical structure and systems of a house, from the roof to the foundation. After the inspection process, the inspector will send the client an inspection report that covers their findings, complete with pictures, analysis and recommendations.

Radon Measurement: Radon is a radioactive gas that comes from the breakdown of naturally occurring uranium in soil and rock. Radon enters homes through openings that are in contact with the ground, such as cracks in the foundation, small openings around pipes, and sump pits. The more radon you are exposed to, and the longer the exposure, the greater the risk of eventually developing lung cancer. The New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) recommends that all homes be tested for radon.

Wood Destroying Insects: New Jersey is one of many states that mandates homebuyers receive a WDI report for a lending institution to grant them a mortgage. A Wood Destroying Insect Report includes comprehensive information on your potential home’s presence or absence of wood-destroying insects like termites, carpenter ants, and other equal offenders. Safeguard Home Inspectors are trained and licensed to perform this important report.

The World Development Explorer (WDX) is a self-service analytics tool for research and business community. It is an interactive and visual environment for exploring The World Development Indicators (WDI) provided by the World Bank. Users will gain insights that influence policies and inspire actions for a better world.

WDI is the World Bank’s premier compilation of cross-country historical data on development. The dataset includes more than 1400 socioeconomic indicators of 200 plus countries over 60 years. It is rich in information about a country's economy, environment, society, and healthcare (The World Bank, 2021).

One unique feature of WDX is the integration of Hofstede's National Culture Dimensions (Hofstede Insights, 2021). Now you can explore cultural diversity and discover how culture may influence socioeconomic and health status of a nation.

WDX is web-based, cloud-hosted, and free for all to use. Users can visually and interactively explore trends and relations and compare countries and regions. The beautiful and insightful charts are of publication-quality and can be readily downloaded for use in blogs, presentations, reports, and papers.

Name: The Aesara Project
Description:
The Aesara Project is a collection of Python projects—built on a fork of Theano named Aesara—that aid in the construction and use of domain-specific compilers for tensor-related computations.

Currently, the Aesara Project primarily serves the probabilistic modeling community through its Probabilistic Programming Language-generating capabilities and model-specific optimizations; however, its scope is not limited to just that.

In the context of statistical modeling, Aesara allows you to focus only on the model. It provides a single, easily customizable form of a model that can be used to encode all the information needed to produce numerical optimizers and samplers.

In other words, users can build a symbolic graph that represents the mathematical operations performed by the model. This graph can be inspected and modified at runtime—thanks to a fully featured and extensible rewrite system—and all without ever leaving Python. Graphs can then be transpiled to a number of supported target languages (e.g. C, Numba, JAX).

Aesara is modular by design and it is straightforward to add new mathematical operators, new rewrite rules (e.g. numerical stabilizations, optimizations, etc.), and even new target languages.

Aesara opens new possibilities in Machine Learning, exemplified by the AePPL and AeMMC libraries.
