Description:
When we think of elevator and escalator safety, many people assume it is the responsibility of the elevator manufacturer and the elevator service company. However, the building owner or manager and the riding public also play a vital role in elevator and escalator safety.

Once elevator or escalator equipment is installed, tested, inspected and put into service, the building owner or manager owns the equipment. As such, it becomes their responsibility to ensure that all components are properly inspected, tested and maintained. The ASME A17.1/CSA B44 Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators provides all the necessary requirements for inspection, testing, maintenance and repair of elevators and escalators:
 
Authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) specifies the required intervals for inspection and testing which may be based on the recommendations in Appendix N Proper maintenance of elevators and escalators is vital. The responsibility falls to the building owner for making sure that each system is properly maintained. Typically, owners hire a service company with trained elevator and escalator mechanics to provide all equipment maintenance. Just like a homeowner: when you buy a home, you’re the one in charge to make all the necessary repairs, if/when a pipe bursts or a foundation cracks. Who do you call in that situation? A professional. 

Every elevator and escalator is required to have a Maintenance Control Program (MCP), which is essentially a detailed guide to ensure proper maintenance throughout the life of the equipment. But building owner responsibility doesn’t end there. 

ElevatorOversight is the industries first, third party, Elevator Maintenance Monitoring service. That's right, we do not perform the maintenance on your elevators, but we do monitor the company you hired to do so to ensure you are getting what you paid for.

Description:
The Beautiful Scar Project’s mission is to provide families grieving the death of their infant due to miscarriage, stillbirth, and neonatal death the tools to turn the loss of their much loved and desired baby into a beautiful scar.
 
Any trauma, either physical or emotional, will create a gaping wound in the person that is traumatized.  After that wound bleeds and subsequently scabs over, a scar will be left behind to tell the story of survival.  If nurtured properly with education and on-going support, the scar that is left behind will be one of beauty that the bearer will be proud to show off and assimilate into their life story.

For a parent, there is no greater trauma than the loss of their child. The trauma of the death of an infant can leave not only a large gaping wound but also ruined finances, shattered marriages and families as well as the complete destruction of ones identity in its path. There is a definitive line in the sand; who they were when their baby was still alive and who they are now that their baby’s heartbeat has ceased to be. No one can go through a battle of any kind unscathed. The same is true for infant loss.

The Beautiful Scar Project’s purpose is to ensure that newly bereaved parents know that they are not alone and that they can and WILL survive the loss of their baby.  The infant loss community locally, nationally as well as internationally has many ongoing support resources such as support groups, online forums, memorial events, memorial jewelry, photography and portraiture available to bereaved parents, however at this time there is no information “hub”.  No one place that a grieving parent can search to find what ongoing support of their grief work is right for them. The Beautiful Scar Project aims to meet that need and to become the informational “hub” in the Denver Metro Area.

Ensuring the accuracy and reliability of law firm information is crucial for law school students. CSO Data solves this problem by using a call center team to personally verify its data as well as proprietary systems to track and update law firm M&A activity.
Finding accurate employer information for your students is further complicated by students who desire to work in cities far away from their alma mater.  In most instances, Career Services Offices do not have information about out-of-state law firms that fall outside of the AM Law 250.  In these cases, Career Services Offices are forced to instruct their students to contact out-of-state law schools under reciprocity agreements and can only guess about what data their students will be provided access to and the accuracy of that information.  CSO Data’s national database allows access to reliable, accurate and detailed data for students regardless of their desired employment location.
CSO Data offers a cost-effective subscription model that can be tailored based upon your school’s needs.

Name: TCPALITIGATORLIST.com
Description:
TCPA Litigator List

Compliance intelligence built to prevent lawsuits — not just pass lists

Most TCPA compliance tools were built to answer a narrow question:

“Do I technically have the right to call this number?”

That question matters — but it’s no longer the one that decides whether your business survives.

The real question modern call centers, lead generators, insurers, mortgage teams, and outbound sales organizations face is this:

“Will this campaign get us sued — how soon, and how badly?”

That’s the problem TCPA Litigator List was built to solve.

From compliance checklists to litigation risk intelligence

Traditional DNC scrubbing platforms focus on list hygiene. They tell you whether a number appears on a registry. That’s necessary — but it’s incomplete.

Lawsuits don’t come from lists.
They come from people. Attorneys. Patterns. Venues.

TCPA Litigator List goes beyond basic compliance by focusing on what actually drives litigation risk:

• Repeat TCPA plaintiffs
• Plaintiff attorney filing behavior
• Jurisdictional and venue trends
• Claim recency and escalation patterns
• Counsel reputation and aggressiveness
• Carrier and portability signals tied to risk exposure

This isn’t just “scrubbing.”

It’s risk intelligence.

We help you understand who is likely to sue you, why, and where your exposure is rising — before a single call is placed.

Purpose-built TCPA risk scoring (not guesswork)

TCPA Litigator List is designed around a core idea:

All calls are not equally risky.

Instead of treating every number as a binary yes/no decision, we assess relative litigation risk across campaigns, lists, and time.

That means:

• Identifying high-risk plaintiffs before they appear in lawsuits
• Tracking attorney filing velocity and escalation signals
• Flagging geographic hot spots where TCPA claims concentrate
• Surfacing trends that generic DNC checks never reveal

The result: smarter suppression, fewer lawsuits, and measurable risk reduction.

Name: Zorzee
Description:
Zorzee is not anti-franchise. It is anti-uninformed.

Franchising is a legitimate, proven way to build wealth. My first franchise worked and professionals like you, have built multi-brand franchise portfolio most executives only dream about. The problem was never franchising. It is that almost everything written about it is written by someone who gets paid when you sign, so buyers decide without a fair, analytical read of the one document that tells the truth.

In 2016 I invested in a franchise. Twenty-two years in the military, eighteen in Special Forces, then JP Morgan and Deloitte. I knew how to read a financial document. I was dead wrong. Every piece of information I had came from a single source: the franchisor. And when I found $321,000 in costs that were never disclosed anywhere in my Franchise Disclosure Document, I had two choices. Find money I did not have, or default on a $526,000 SBA loan before I opened the doors.

I found the money. I survived. That is not the part that matters. The information I needed existed. It was in the document. I just did not know how to read it, and there was no resource I trusted that would teach me without also trying to sell me something.
That is the gap Zorzee closes: a fair, analytical read of the filing itself.

Zorzee is a franchise intelligence publication built on publicly filed Franchise Disclosure Documents. More than 650 brands, each read straight from its current filing and put in plain language. Every number traces to a specific Item in a specific document. 

Zorzee earns zero from franchisors. No commissions. No placement fees. No sponsored content. A brand appears because it has a filing on record. That is the only qualification.

You are not shopping. You are underwriting a business investment. So read the document.

Built for Operators. Not Gamblers.

Name: Experience Capitalization
Description:
Experience Capitalization is a new enterprise category created and developed by Alexander Granovskiy, the Originator and Architect of Experience Capitalization.
It defines how companies turn work-created operational experience into reusable, verified, company-owned business capital.
Every serious work process creates more than an output.
It also creates experience: what worked, what failed, what was corrected, what was rejected, what should be reused, and what should not be repeated.
Most companies capture the visible result of work and lose the experience created during the work.
This creates Experience Debt: repeated mistakes, repeated explanations, repeated investigations, repeated rework, slower onboarding, and lost operational judgment when people leave.
Experience Capitalization captures and refines this experience so it can improve future work instead of disappearing after the task is finished.
The concept includes Experience Debt, Reusable Experience, Experience Refinery, Experience Environment, Experiential Capital, Experience Threshold, Experience Activation, and the Enterprise Experience Layer.
The practical purpose is to make business experience usable by people, AI systems, automation tools, workflows, CRM systems, ERP systems, support operations, and enterprise software.
Experience Capitalization treats operational experience as an asset that can accumulate, be maintained, be activated, and compound over time.
It is especially important in the AI automation era, because faster work can also lose experience faster unless the experience created by work is captured and reused.
Alexander Granovskiy is the Originator and Architect of Experience Capitalization.

There’s a moment restaurant operators know all too well. A manager hunched over a back-office screen buried in spreadsheets, chasing reports, reconciling data that doesn’t talk to each other while the floor runs itself. Or doesn’t.
That’s the problem Axial Shift was built to solve.

Most restaurant technology keeps AI locked inside closed applications with limited context. Labor data lives in one place. Sales data lives in another. Guest behavior somewhere else entirely. And because those systems don’t connect, the intelligence they produce is narrow. Operators get fragments when they need the full picture.

Axial Shift is different. We connect operational data across the entire organization which gives AI the context it needs to actually be useful, and gives managers the clarity they need to lead.

The result: managers get out of the back office and back onto the floor. Where their teams are. Where guests are. Where every great shift is actually won.

We built Axial around a simple belief: the best thing a manager can do is run a better shift. Not build a better report. Run a better shift. That means real-time visibility into what’s happening right now, forecasting that reflects how the whole operation moves together, and tools that surface the right action at the right moment.

Dialogue - A specific study allowing members to detail the problems and obstacles encountered is collected by the Chamber to agree on the most effective strategies and actions to mitigate the possible negative impacts on their investments. • Inteligência de mercado e expansão de distribuição.  
• Gestão de Sell In, Sell Through, estoque e positivação.  
• Identificação de oportunidades de crescimento e novos PDVs.  
• Gestão de ruptura, demanda e disponibilidade de produtos.  
• Gestão de mix, fidelização e comportamento de compra.  
• Gestão de metas, performance comercial e produtividade de equipes.  

O que nos diferencia 

• Visão integrada da cadeia: indústria + distribuidores + PDVs.  
• Dados censitários de mercado, não amostrais.  
• Mais de 15 anos de especialização no canal indireto.  
• Plataforma proprietária de qualidade de dados (MIND).  

Como parte da NielsenIQ, ampliamos nossa capacidade analítica e fortalecemos a visão Full ViewTM, contribuindo para uma compreensão mais completa da dinâmica de mercado, desde a distribuição até o ponto de venda.

Name: DC Corrections Information Council
Description:
The District of Columbia Corrections Information Council (CIC) is an independent monitoring body mandated by the US Congress and the DC Council to inspect, monitor, and report on the conditions of confinement at facilities where DC residents are incarcerated.  This includes facilities operated by the Federal Bureau of Prisons (FBOP), the DC Department of Corrections (DOC), and private contractors.  The CIC reports its observations and recommendations to the DC Mayor, the DC Council, Congresswoman Norton, the DC Deputy Mayor for Public Safety and Justice, the Director of the FBOP, the Director of the DOC, and the DC community.

The CIC was established by the Revitalization Act of 1997 and expanded through the District of Columbia Jail Improvement Act of 2003.  Through its mandate, the CIC collects information from many different sources, including facility inspections, communication with incarcerated DC residents, and community outreach.  During site visits, the CIC inspects a facility, interviews staff and DC residents at the facility, and assesses programs and services available to inmates.  The CIC releases reports on inspected facilities, along with an annual report addressing broader issues affecting the conditions of confinement of incarcerated DC residents.

The CIC does not provide direct services, and it does not act as a personal attorney or provide legal representation or advice.  However, all information from DC residents is important to the CIC and its purpose of providing accurate information on the conditions of confinement of DC residents.  The CIC reviews all reports, concerns, and other information that is received, and individuals are strongly encouraged to contact the CIC regarding their experiences.  All information the CIC receives is kept confidential and anonymous.  The CIC does not give out specific names or confidential information to any person, any agency, or the government without the express permission of the provider of the information.

All of our members’ profiles show their contact information, reviews, and experience, which enhances the user's experience by making it quick and easy to shop for the right person for their claim.


The Movement

A Baby Boomer is defined as being born between 1946 and 1964. So the youngest of us is 50+. What a great ride it has been for our trendsetting, influential generation! Here at Boomer Connections, we feel the best is yet to come and we are dedicated to helping our tribe navigate and maximize the experience. Isn’t this what we were always about? Living life to the fullest.

The 50+ years are full of both opportunities and challenges, defined by fewer responsibilities or more, depending on your situation. Children may be leaving the nest, but aging parents may require our attention. Many of us are approaching or in retirement, facing new lifestyles and different financial concerns, with many new choices to be made. All these changes bring up concerns, questions, the need to share.
 
 
Our Mission Statement: 
 
BoomerConnections.com provides a meeting place online for the Baby Boomer demographic to: 
		• share life experiences and stories
		• engage and connect with each other and their community 
		• address challenges 
		• stay informed

using a tool that is both fun and easy to navigate. We empower Boomers to experience these years as the most enjoyable and rewarding of their lives.

Description:
Omega Alert Stock Information Services (OASIS, LLC) provides a subscription for independent investors committed to weekly swing trading in the U. S. Stock Markets.

Swing trading is a stock investing strategy that attempts to capture gains in a stock within one to five days. It sits in the middle of the continuum between day trading and trend following. OASIS subscribers hold a particular stock for a five days and trade the stock on the basis of its intra-week oscillations between optimism and pessimism.

To find likely stocks that move in such a short time frame, traders must act very quickly. Although large brokerage firms and institutions trade in sizes too big to move quickly in and out of stocks, the independent trader is able to exploit short-term stock movements without the competition of the major traders.

Swing trade analysts look for stocks with short-term price trends, patterns and momentum rather than the fundamental value of stocks.
Subscribers are not required to conduct any analysis because Patrick Arnone, Chief Analyst at Omega Alert Stock Information Services, performs the analysis, and provides the investment suggestions.

Name: meeting.toolchest.org
Description:
Remote meetings are a lot easier to get right than many people realise. People use remote meetings because of their convenience, but by taking a different approach remote meetings can actually be more effective and engaging than most physical meetings. 

The internet provides different opportunities for collaboration, and these tools can be used to better achieve our meeting objectives. We should stop seeing remote meetings as a ‘pale reflection of the real thing’ and start seeing their potential to rectify what has become a source of inefficiency and frustration in many organisations. 

But not everything has to change at once, and there are many good practices we can take from physical meetings to ensure we get the best out of remote meetings. Adopting some of the practices below will help you to improve immediately and set you on a path to creating meetings which fully reflect your leadership. 

There are six areas to explore in thinking about making your remote meetings more effective:
•	Assembly - Having the right people, in the right place, at the right time, ready
•	Alignment - Agreeing a clear purpose and the practical steps to get there
•	Activity - Using the potential of the internet to engage full participation
•	Attention - Facilitating practices which help listening and understanding
•	Action - Building ownership of outcomes and actions to ensure progress
•	Assessment - Learning from experience and observation to improve further

Meeting Toolchest is a free online resource which has been created to support and promote all of the above - meetings which inspire and empower people to transform their organisations and themselves. It provides ideas, guidance, tools, and resources to support a simple step-by-step path to improvement that is open to everybody who runs and attends meetings. 

To get started, simply go to https://meeting.toolchest.org set yourself up a free account, and then follow your nose.

Discerno Cyber provides AI-native cybersecurity diligence for M&A built around two ideas deal teams already understand: focus and sequencing, to deliver value earlier in the process before terms are set. 

Focus starts with the deal thesis. What are you buying, and what cyber failure could impair that value? An IP acquisition, AI capability, customer-data play, acqui-hire, roll-up, or platform expansion should not receive the same cyber review. Discerno maps the thesis to the assets at risk, likely failure modes, material controls, and evidence needed to support a deal decision.

Sequencing means the analysis deepens as deal certainty increases. Early in the process, buyers need fast, low-cost signal from public information and available target materials before leverage disappears. As the deal advances, Discerno expands into SOC 2, PCI, SIG and other trust documents, questionnaires, interviews, and deeper control review.

The point is not to run a full cyber assessment earlier. The point is to run the right analysis at the right depth at the right time.

Every stage produces deal-relevant output:

technical finding → business impact → deal-term input.

That can mean a valuation discount, purchase price adjustment, escrow holdback, indemnity, representation and warranty, termination trigger, or post-close remediation plan.

Discerno is powered by responsible AI and grounded in doctoral research on thesis-driven cybersecurity due diligence. AI lets us process more evidence earlier with appropriate context. Our proprietary methodology keeps this work reviewable, repeatable, and tied to the transaction.

Cyber diligence should not be a late blocker or generic remediation report. It should help buyers protect the thesis, spend diligence dollars in proportion to deal certainty, and change terms before leverage is gone.

Incremental Diligence - Scoped to the thesis. Staged to the deal. Built for the people who price it.

For example one of our co-founder’s lost two immediate family members during this time and their family is still discovering and handling the processing of their loved ones estate while also grieving for their loss.

Within traditional legal models, this is reduced, but only minimally, by way of various vehicles such as a Last Will and Testament, Power of Attorneys, and Trusts. Executor’s Key is an online platform designed to automate the estate planning process through the application of new technologies and interchanges both in the Traditional Finance #TradFi and Decentralized Finance #DeFi spaces. The main differentiation of Executor’s Key is its focus on the human emotional element after the passing of an individual and centralizes on removing the confusion, friction, time and effort required by the estate executor, which is normally a loved one, during the grieving period. 

Through the combination of end-to-end encryption, Know Your Customer (KYC) processes, FinTech, and natural language processing (NLP), Executor’s Key provides a secure, dependable, and digital way to share all of accounts, passwords, assets, and other such private and critical items - but only after you pass on and in accord with your intentions.

Name: Simularity Foundation
Description:
When there is transparency about what is actually happening, people are better able to make informed decisions.

In this age of rampant, well-funded disinformation campaigns, the truth is getting harder to find, and harder to trust.

Most organizations and even whole countries don’t have access to the tools, skills, and data needed to identify what is (or isn’t) really happening.

The Simularity Foundation is able to shine a light on situations and deeds that bad actors try to keep hidden. We illuminate them with undeniable imagery and unbiased, fact-based analysis.

The Simularity Foundation  is organized and operated exclusively for charitable purposes in accordance with Section 501(c)(3) of the US Internal Revenue Code. It provides free reports of the results of our investigations, based on geospatial and temporal data, to illuminate what is happening in our world.  

We aim to eliminate environmental and social injustice, illicit activity, violence, human rights violations, and cruelty to all creatures by researching, documenting, and exposing it so that the press and law enforcement can take appropriate action.

Our objectives are: 
To investigate and report on activities that are determined to meet the criteria described in our mission
To disseminate accurate, well-documented reports of our investigations freely to all interested parties
To recruit volunteers and train them in our research methods to support our mission
To sponsor, host and/or participate in events and activities that promote freedom of information, the causes we champion, geospatial analysis, and software research to continue to improve our analysis tools.

AccuLytx provides accurate valuation, analysis and demographics for residential properties in the United States. AccuLytx is the culmination of a three year effort to create an application that reports the market value of residential property.

The application is fast, accurate and includes detailed analysis. Typically, the two largest purchases that an individual makes in their lifetime are a home and a car. These purchases require individuals to complete a detailed financial analysis to determine the market value of the purchase. It is logical to make a small investment to obtain the information necessary for that analysis. Currently, information for purchasing an automobile is available through sources such as Edmunds, Kelly Blue Book, truecar.com or CarFax. Information for the largest acquisition, a home, has not been so readily available and the accuracy of the information is in question. AccuLytx has changed that paradigm. We like to say that, “AccuLytx does not help you find a home to purchase, we help you determine if you should purchase a particular home”.

Using proprietary algorithms, public information, private information, best appraisal practices and meta data, AccuLytx calculates the market value of a residential property. The report includes the value of the target property, demographics of the neighborhood, health of the neighborhood, cautionary factors, etc. This information is invaluable for negotiating the purchase price of a home and determining loan value for a funding institution. It is not uncommon for a real estate contract to be rejected by a funding institution because the property purchase price exceeds the appraised value.

We watched case managers keep intake on sticky notes, billing teams fax the same document three times, notaries courier affidavits across town, and supervisors spend Fridays on "where is this case?" calls. None of these people were the problem. The handoffs were.

Every personal injury case crosses three separate offices before anyone gets paid: the attorney managing the claim, the ER facility delivering care and billing for it, and the notary making those bills court-ready. So we mapped every handoff, 18 lifecycle stages across seven roles, and built software where each one is a tracked event on one shared record instead of a gap where a case can quietly disappear.

What SettleTrack does:
One shared case record from the first phone call to final payment. Live role-based dashboards for case managers, front desk, billing, notaries, and LOP supervisors. Rejections carry reasons and route themselves to the right team. Offers, acceptance, and payments are logged with a complete, timestamped audit trail.

Who it's for:
Personal injury attorneys, ER facilities, notaries, and referral partners who work Letter of Protection cases and are done with fax machines, status calls, and documents that vanish between offices.

Built to the standards this work demands:
HIPAA safeguards, SOC 2-modeled controls, AES-256 encryption, role-based access, and ESIGN/UETA-compliant digital signatures.

The result: complete, verified documentation, faster settlements, and providers who get paid sooner.

Stop chasing paperwork. Start tracking cases

Name: Acquisition Edge
Description:
I help PE firms, roll-up operators, and business brokers find acquisition targets before they hit the market.

THE PROBLEM:
By the time a company lists with a broker, you're competing against 20 other buyers. Bidding wars drive up prices. Quality deals disappear. Most "lead lists" are recycled data everyone else has already seen.

WHAT I BUILT:
Acquisition Edge tracks 5,000+ businesses and scores them on two dimensions:

→ Exit Readiness: Is the owner ready to sell?
 • Owner disengagement (stopped responding to customers)
 • Succession gaps (20+ year business, no clear successor)
 • Financial stress (tax liens, complaints spiking)
 • Exit preparation (hiring CFO/COO, professionalizing)

→ Business Quality: Is this worth buying?
 • Strong reputation (4.5+ ratings, positive reviews)
 • Clean compliance (active licenses, no violations)
 • Growth signals (hiring activity, review velocity)
 • Revenue/size indicators (employee estimates, loan data)

We only surface targets that score high on BOTH. Exit-ready but unhealthy businesses are filtered out.

WHAT YOU GET:
- Weekly ranked target lists (PDF + CSV)
- Complete profiles: ownership, executives, revenue estimates, contact info
- Exit + Health scores with signal breakdowns
- Real-time alerts when high-priority targets show new signals
- Exclusive territory (one client per state per sector)

MY BACKGROUND:
15 years building enterprise data systems as a Director of Engineering. Now I apply that expertise to acquisition intelligence, helping you spot the right companies long before your competitors do.

WHO THIS IS FOR:
- Business brokers (find listings before your competitors)
- Roll-up operators (source off-market deals in your sector)
- PE deal teams (pipeline quality targets 6-12 months early)
- Search fund operators (find your acquisition faster)
- Buy-side M&A consultants (deliver better deal flow to clients)

GovTech providers remain in control of their customer relationships, agency accounts, publishing workflows, platforms, and services. Aigistry does not replace existing GovTech platforms or require agencies to adopt a new publishing system. Instead, approved GovTech providers connect their existing platforms to the National AI Feed as a downstream machine-readable publishing layer for AI systems.

As artificial intelligence systems increasingly act as intermediaries between governments and the public, errors in attribution, jurisdiction, authority, and recency are becoming more visible. Aigistry provides a machine-readable registry designed so AI systems can more reliably identify authoritative sources, attribute statements to the correct authority, and cite information with clear provenance and timestamps.

The National AI Feed is the public, machine-readable publication generated by the registry. It delivers verified government communications in a standardized format designed for artificial intelligence systems, preserving authority, provenance, jurisdiction, timestamps, and cryptographic integrity from publication through citation.

Government agencies participate through approved GovTech providers. Existing workflows remain in place. GovTech providers remain in control. Aigistry operates downstream—providing shared infrastructure that helps official government information become more discoverable, attributable, and reliable for AI systems.

The DAGS Governing Body is the steward responsible for maintaining the integrity of the Deployment AI Governance Standard (DAGS). DAGS exists to formalize execution-time governance as infrastructure in high-risk AI deployments.

DAGS is designed to operate beneath and alongside existing AI governance regimes, providing the deployment-level controls required for those frameworks to be credible in practice.

The Governing Body exercises normative authority over the standard, including interpretation of its requirements, scope, and meaning. It issues authoritative clarifications, maintains the canonical text of the specification, and protects the technical and governance integrity of the standard over time.

The Governing Body operates under a formal charter defining its authority over the normative specification while leaving implementation and commercial activity to the broader ecosystem.

The DAGS Governing Body does not:
- Provide consulting or advisory services
- Sell certifications or assessments
- Implement governance programs
- Endorse vendors, tools, or service providers

Commercial services related to DAGS, where permitted, are delivered independently by licensed third parties and are not operated, managed, or controlled by the Governing Body.

DAGS exists to ensure that AI deployment governance is legible, defensible, and structurally sound, regardless of who implements it.

Name: Billy Guide
Description:
The BILLY Guide is here to help (elderly) people stay safe online.
It’s a step-by-step guide designed to protect you from identity theft, help you recover if it happens, and show you how to safely connect with banks, government services, and other websites.
We created BILLY to be clear, comforting, and easy to follow—even if you're not very familiar with technology.

 WHAT DOES BILLY STAND FOR?
BILLY is an easy way to remember what to do if you think your identity has been stolen:

B – Block any more unauthorized access
I – Investigate what happened
L – List any accounts or personal information that may be affected
L – Limit future risk with alerts and monitoring
Y – Your digital safety is restored

  A GENTLE REMINDER FOR PEACE OF MIND
Identity theft can be scary and stressful.
So, BILLY is also a reminder to take care of your emotional well-being:

B – Breathe – stay calm and take things one step at a time
I – It will be alright – most companies have ways to protect you and fix the damage
L – Look out for each other – check in with your spouse, family, or friends
L – Lean on others – ask a trusted person to help you if needed
Y – You're not alone – the BILLY team is here to support you

 WHO CREATED THE BILLY GUIDE?
My name is Martijn Loderus and I work in Cyber Security and Identity Management. I started this guide after some of my elderly loved ones became victims of identity theft.
At the time, they didn’t know where to turn or what steps to take. It was confusing and overwhelming. I created BILLY Guide to change that.

By the way—Billy was 95 years old when he experienced identity theft. This guide is named in his honor.

Pre-law applicants comparing schools beyond US News rankings. Attorneys check their alma mater here, or scout where to lateral. Admissions consultants pull clean data they'd otherwise spend an afternoon collating. Journalists and researchers covering legal education read 509α.
